name: Marco Bellini
bio: Marco's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the Politecnico di Milano, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. After graduating, he gained experience in smaller racing teams, working his way up from data acquisition to race engineering. Marco thrives on the challenge of extracting every last bit of performance from the kart and driver. He meticulously analyzes telemetry data, identifying areas for improvement in both setup and driving technique. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and concisely to the driver and mechanics. Marco's dedication to perfection and his proactive approach make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Marco is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a lucky wrench that he uses for critical adjustments.
Often hums quietly to himself while analyzing data.
